name: 实现 ConfigStoreService
description:
实现 ConfigStoreService 服务方法: readConfig, writeConfig
  - readConfig: readConfig(filePath: string): Promise<ProjectData[]> pre=filePath 存在且为有效路径，当前进程有读取权限
  - writeConfig: writeConfig(filePath: string, data: ProjectData[]): Promise<void> pre=data 符合 ProjectData 结构，当前进程对目标目录有写入权限
